## X-Sense Home Security v1.4.14.3

### 🛟 Detector Entities
- Restores detector end-of-life reporting as an `End-of-Life` problem entity for smoke, CO, and combination detectors.
- Restores `Report Time` for detector/device report timestamps.
- Restores the CO alarm standard as `CO Alarm Standard`, shown as `EN 50291` or `UL 2034` to match the X-Sense app behavior.

### 🧹 Entity Cleanup
- Keeps restored detector entities out of obsolete-entity cleanup so Home Assistant does not mark them as no longer provided.
